hello-world.README.md:
# hello-world

Run `ace app test . --output ../result --store ../history`.
The ACE Python profile accepts one JSON request on stdin and emits one JSON response.
No third-party dependencies are downloaded.
Inspect ace-app.json and dependencies.lock.json for the fixed runtime contract.

Direct trusted-example usage: `echo '{"name":"ACE"}' | python3 main.py`

calculator.README.md:
# calculator

Run `ace app test . --output ../result --store ../history`.
Send one JSON request on stdin to `python3 main.py`.
No third-party dependencies are downloaded.
Examples: {"op":"add","a":2,"b":3}
